utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s really coming together nicely—people are pitching in tools, parts, and a lot of goodwill. And don’t forget, it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s shaping up well. I’m glad everyone’s pitching in for the repair drive this Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — and Eli’s got a clear list of drop-off items, so that should keep things moving. I’ll be watching for any new tools or updates this afternoon and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them for anything off. First stop is my place, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, first stop is your place, and I’m lining it up around the school schedule and around 3. I’ll send the details once I’ve got the time and place set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send them over once it’s set, and I’ll take a quick look. I’m just checking that first stop at my place lines up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to run errands and ask around for updates. I should be home around 3, and Leo can stop by then if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still not fully set for this afternoon, right? If Leo comes by around 3, that’s just if the timing gets confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Right, it’s still tentative for this afternoon. I’ll check while I’m out, and Oren or Vik should let me know if anything gets confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — if you hear the repair drive times, please send them my way and I’ll work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’m planning to stop by around 3, and I’ll pass along any updates on the repair drive times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — 3 works for me, and I’ll keep an eye out for the repair drive times.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help with the sorting and a few basic repairs. Once Faye tells me what fits around pickup, I’ll send over a couple of times that should work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. I’m planning to get there a little early so I can sort out parking, and it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll plan on Saturday at 10 and be there to help with sorting and a few basic repairs. Thanks for handling the parking early, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive is still this afternoon, as far as I’ve got it. Folks can drop off tools and check what still needs fixing, and I’ll let Eli know once I pin down the full plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep organizing who needs what, check with Uli and Cleo on any gaps, and keep folks posted. Once Rosa locks in the time and place, I’ll spread the word and remind everyone to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll keep an ear out too and let Ira know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll jump in late and take whichever small gap still needs filling.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Dane — I’ll keep you in the loop once Oren sends the plan and arrival time. The drive is Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and I’ll bring the drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — that works for me. I’ll stay ready and just fill whatever small gap is left when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there this Saturday at the community hall to help sort donations, and I’m bringing the tool bag plus a few extra tools around 3 this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — I’m still waiting on the final repair drive time and place, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear. Sounds like it’s being kept pretty simple, which should help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know when you hear the final details, and I’ll be ready with the tool bag and extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure we still need volunteers yet, so I should check before saying more. I’ll confirm the start time too and let Mina know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana. I may have missed a detail or two, so let’s check with Vik about organizing and keep everyone posted for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good — I’ll check the details with Vik and confirm the time before we tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ve got Rey down for duct tape and a screwdriver, and Mina as a volunteer. We still need a few more hands and a couple more screwdrivers for Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nice, I’m spreading the word too — the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll make sure Pia has the details, and Vik’s on it as well.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks — I’ll keep the list as Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and I still need a couple more screwdrivers plus a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We’re still a little short on hands, but I’ll bring duct tape and a screwdriver Saturday at 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that helps — I’ll be at the community center parking lot tomorrow morning, and I remember the first stop is Bo’s place. Eli should have the drop-off list too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — that’ll help a lot. See you Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still waiting on your final time and place so I can pass it along to Nell. Once you confirm it, I’ll keep the repair drive small and let Dane know where to jump in when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s set for Sunday at the community center. I’ll send Bo the details to review, and you can let Nell and Dane know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Perfect — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll let Nell know right away, and I’ll keep Dane posted for when he comes in late.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m planning to get there a little early so I can figure out parking. It’s still this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Almost — it’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, not 10 a.m. at the community center. I’d still go a little early for parking, though.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks for catching that — I’ll plan on Saturday afternoon at the community hall and still leave a bit early for parking.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, the repair drive is Saturday at 10 at the community center. I’m bringing duct tape and a screwdriver, and I may ask a couple neighbors to lend a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll spread the word and keep sorting who needs what. I’ll check in with Uli and Cleo about any gaps, too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik—that’d help a lot. If Uli or Cleo can jump in, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and Bo’s place is the first stop. It’s for broken household items and small furniture, but I’m not sure yet if they still need volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll start with Bo’s place, then line up the rest around the school schedule and keep everyone posted. Once the time and place are locked in, I’ll let Nell and Leo know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — just make sure Rosa sends the details, and keep in mind Dane will join a bit late for a small part of it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and remember, your place is the first stop on the repair drive route. It’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. over at the community center, and it’s really shaping up nicely with folks bringing tools and parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the repair drive details and I’ll take a quick look for anything off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’m keeping an eye out this afternoon and I’ll pass along any updates I hear, especially if anything still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can volunteer if you still need people. Want me to check whether there’s anything else you need brought?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, thanks. If you can bring any spare screws or a flashlight, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll see if I can bring some spare screws and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m sending Bo the details to review. Vik’s also helping line up needs and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — Bo’s place is still the first stop, right? I’ll head to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Bo’s place is still our first stop, and thank you for heading to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning. I’ll make sure the details stay lined up for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m keeping the repair drive small and straightforward. If Dane shows up late, I’ll point him to the part that still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I may have missed a detail or two, so can Vik help organize who needs what for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, Vik can help sort that out for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m making sure Pia has the details for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and I’m still spreading the word. Nell’s still getting the info, and Vik’s on it too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’m heading out to run errands, and I should be home around 3. If you hear anything else on the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll pass along anything new about the repair drive. Hope the errands go smoothly!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, the repair drive’s still this afternoon, and folks can drop off tools and check what still needs fixing. I’m still sorting out the plan and time, but I’ll let Eli know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m still set to help Leo with sorting donations and any basic repairs. Just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll pass the update along to Faye too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send the time as soon as I sort it out. Appreciate you passing it along to Faye too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking the start time for Saturday afternoon at the community hall. Rey can also bring duct tape and a screwdriver, which will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo—please send me the start time when you have it, and I’ll work around school pickups. The extra supplies sound great.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I will — I’m checking it now and I’ll send the start time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still not fully locked in yet, right? If Rosa confirms the time and place, then we’ll know for sure?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, not fully locked in yet. Once Rosa confirms the time and place, we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — so it’s still this afternoon in the plan, but the exact time and place are still waiting on Rosa, right?
